name: Voxel Grid Occlusion Estimation
definition: A method to estimate occluded space in a scene by building a voxel grid from a point cloud and performing ray traversal from a sensor origin to target voxels to determine if they are free (0) or occluded/occupied (1).
summary: Voxel Grid Occlusion Estimation determines if voxels are free or occupied by performing ray traversal from a sensor origin, distinguishing it from standard voxelization by adding visibility checks.
